claims: According to Wikipedia, El Niño is the warm phase.
According to Wikipedia, La Niña is the cold phase.
According to Wikipedia, El Niño and La Niña are opposing, natural climate patterns in the tropical Pacific Ocean.
According to Wikipedia, El Niño and La Niña are known as the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) cycle.
El Niño and La Niña affect global weather every 2–7 years.
A 2026 forecast shows El Niño potentially bringing warmer, drier conditions to the northern U.S.
A 2026 forecast shows La Niña bringing wetter, cooler conditions to the northern U.S.
